inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 876.9M common outstanding at 2026-08-21 (Q2 FY2027 10-Q cover) + 21.8M common issuable on conversion of the NVIDIA Series A Convertible Preferred (conversion price ~$91.84, deep in the money, participates as-converted) + 23.8M dilutive stock awards/warrant shares (Q2 FY2027 EPS note, treasury method). Cross-check: Q2 FY2027 weighted diluted 921.2M. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. The up-to-22.4M Celestial earn-out shares are NOT in the count; they are charged through the contingent-consideration liability in equity_bridge instead (once, not twice). The customer warrant issued 2026-08-18 (58.97M shares, strike 206.58, vesting on revenue milestones through FY2033; Q2 FY2027 10-Q Part II and Note 15) is out of the money at the current price and at every scenario value, so the treasury method adds nothing; if the stock trades well above the strike it becomes up to ~6% dilution. No Lumentum shares are included: the deal has not closed.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 10-K cash flow statement: SBC add-back 590.8 + tax withholding paid for net share settlement 240.7 (financing) = 831.5. The 10-K publishes no combined adjusted-EBITDA figure, so the two lines are summed per the house rule. Forward sbc_pct_path is on the expense basis and is anchored to H1 FY2027 (533.8 on 5,157.1 revenue = 10.4%; Q2 alone 326.2 = 11.9%), which already exceeds the FY2026 combined ratio of 10.1%.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Risk-free ~4.3% (10-year US Treasury, approximate, not re-fetched), equity risk premium ~4.5-5%, normalised beta ~1.3 (raw beta is far higher; the stock traded 70.69-329.88 inside twelve months) gives cost of equity ~10.5%. Debt is ~3% of capital so WACC is ~10%. The same 10% is used in all three scenarios: customer-concentration and AI-cycle risk is charged through the scenario paths and the 25% bear weight, not through a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: lease cost sits inside opex and therefore inside EBITDA; lease liabilities (~320 at FY2026) are not in net debt. One treatment, no separate lease path.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (routing table row 1: operating company, tech; no MEMORY.md entry, first valuation). FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 2026-01-31); year 1 = FY2027, of which H1 is actual (revenue 5,157.1, +32%). Timing convention: year 1 ends 2027-01-30 but is discounted a full year (end-of-year house convention), which understates value by a few percent; partly offsetting, the 2026-08-01 balance sheet already holds H1 FY2027 cash flow that year 1 counts again (~0.4-0.5/share). Net debt = 4,999.9 principal borrowings less 3,932.8 cash; cash includes the 2.0bn NVIDIA preferred proceeds (the as-converted shares are in the count) and the 2.5bn automotive-ethernet sale proceeds. Interest income is not stripped: the company is in net debt. FY2026 adjusted EBITDA anchor = operating income 1,322.9 + D&A 348.6 + acquired-intangible amortisation 942.0 + SBC 590.8 + restructuring 15.5 = 3,219.8 (39.3%); H1 FY2027 on the same basis 38.2%, Q2 ~39.9%. da_pct excludes acquired-intangible amortisation (non-cash, and its tax shield is captured in the low starting cash tax rate: FY2026 cash taxes were 92.1). capex_pct includes payments on technology-licence obligations, which Marvell reports in financing (128.3 in FY2026, 56.6 in H1 FY2027) but which are recurring EDA/IP capex; reported_fcf follows the CSV definition (OCF less PP&E) and does not deduct them. Working capital is NEGATIVE capture (-30% of revenue change): receivables + inventory + capacity prepayments exceed payables, and H1 FY2027 working capital absorbed 660. Buybacks: a real repurchaser (2,040 in FY2026, 400 in H1 FY2027, 5.1bn authorised remaining), so the flat count is funded; but the count still rose from ~870M to ~921M in six months through NON-SBC issuance (24.5M shares for Celestial, 21.8M as-converted to NVIDIA), all of which is already in the count used. Guidance: FY2027 ~12bn, Q3 FY2027 ~3.15bn +/-5%, FY2028 ~18bn, Q3 adjusted gross margin 57.5-58.5% - all taken from MRVL_Analysis.json (earnings release of 2026-08-27; the press release is not in Extracted/, so these are not verified against a primary document here). The Analysis JSON also carries a contradictory line about a Q3 data-center revenue decline that its own author flags as unverified; the revenue guide is used. Q3 FY2027 results are due ~2026-12-01 and will supersede the year-1 judgment. PENDING LUMENTUM MERGER: per MRVL_Analysis.json, on 2026-11-02 Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum Holdings in an all-stock deal (4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share, Marvell holders ~67% of the combined company, close expected H1 calendar 2028, China approval required). It is not in any filing in the folder. This valuation is STANDALONE Marvell: no Lumentum flows, shares, debt or synergies. If the deal closes, roughly 450M new shares are issued and per-share value depends on what Lumentum is worth against the ~33% of the combined company it receives; that cannot be judged without a Lumentum model. The price is a regular close but the stock is extremely volatile (monthly closes 78.92 to 297.89 within 2026); treat any upside/downside figure as short-lived.
warnings: Pending all-stock acquisition of Lumentum (announced 2026-11-02, close expected H1 calendar 2028) is NOT modelled; this is a standalone valuation and the share count excludes the ~450M shares the deal would issue.
Guidance figures (FY2027 ~12bn, FY2028 ~18bn, Q3 ~3.15bn) come from the Analysis JSON, not from a primary document in the folder.
FY2026 net income (2,670.1) and EPS (3.07) include a 1,830.4 pre-tax gain on the automotive-ethernet sale; neither is a usable earnings base.
Q3 FY2027 results due ~2026-12-01; the stock traded 70.69-329.88 within twelve months.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is not usable as the growth anchor: the 5-year figure (11.1%) is the Inphi/Innovium stock issuance of FY2022, not retained earnings, and the 3-year figure (-2.9%) reflects GAAP losses from acquired-intangible amortisation plus buybacks. EPS CAGRs are undefined (GAAP losses FY2021-FY2025; FY2026 EPS is inflated by the divestiture gain). Revenue 3-year CAGR is used as the reference, and the forward path is driven by H1 FY2027 actuals rather than by any trailing CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF (OCF less PP&E) less SBC less net-share-settlement taxes, applied to every year FY2021-FY2026. Over five years owner FCF grew 9.4%/yr against 14.5% for reported FCF: SBC plus settlement taxes rose from 350 to 832, so a growing share of reported cash flow is paid for in stock. The 3-year owner figure (23.1%) is flattered by a weak FY2023 base. Annual rows only; standalone Q4 rows do not exist, Q3 FY2026 has no FCF, and quarterly SBC is mostly missing, so no TTM series was built.

base.rationale: Year 1 (FY2027) is management's ~12bn outlook raised at Q2 FY2027 results (H1 actual 5,157.1 + Q3 guide ~3.15bn +/-5% leaves ~3.7bn for Q4). Year 2 takes 16.8bn against management's ~18bn FY2028 outlook: a ~7% haircut because the outlook is 14+ months out, rests on a few custom programmes, and Q3 gross margin was guided down on mix. EBITDA margin anchored to FY2026 39.3% and Q2 FY2027 ~39.9%, rising to 44% (high-30s non-GAAP operating margin plus ~4pt depreciation; custom silicon carries lower gross margin, hence the slow ramp). SBC anchored to H1 FY2027 10.4%, gliding to 6%. Cash tax starts near the current single-digit cash rate and ramps to 15-16% as the 15% global minimum tax applies and acquired-intangible shields run off. Cap 18x rather than 20x for a customer-concentrated, cyclical semiconductor business.

scenario_narratives.base: Data Center (79% of Q2 FY2027 revenue, +46% YoY) keeps compounding as hyperscaler custom XPU programmes (AWS Trainium, Microsoft Maia) and electro-optics ramp. FY2027 lands on management's ~12bn outlook; FY2028 reaches 16.8bn, short of the ~18bn outlook; growth then decelerates steadily to single digits by year 7 as the AI build-out matures. Revenue ends year 10 at ~36bn. Custom silicon dilutes gross margin (Q3 FY2027 adjusted gross margin was guided down to 57.5-58.5%), so EBITDA margin only climbs from 39.5% to 44%; SBC falls from the acquisition-inflated 10.5% to 6%; cash tax normalises to 16%. Mature owner-FCF margin ~27%. Standalone Marvell only: the pending Lumentum merger is not modelled.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's outlook is met in full - ~12bn in FY2027 and ~18bn in FY2028 - because Marvell holds next-generation XPU sockets at several hyperscalers, the NVIDIA partnership (2.0bn preferred investment) opens a second route to market, and Celestial's photonic interconnect becomes a volume product (the earn-out pays in full). Revenue reaches ~28bn in FY2030 and ~48bn in year 10; operating leverage on a largely fixed R&D base lifts EBITDA margin to 47% and SBC falls to 5.5%. This needs three largely independent things to go right: programme wins against Broadcom, optical share, and no pause in hyperscaler capex. Even here the value sits below the 206.58 strike of the 59M-share customer warrant, so no warrant dilution is added.
scenario_narratives.bear: Top-10 customers are 82% of revenue and a handful of custom programmes carry the growth. FY2028 comes in at ~14bn rather than 18bn as a lead hyperscaler second-sources or in-houses its next XPU generation, then AI capex enters a digestion phase: FY2029 revenue falls 12% and the business recovers only at mid-single digits, ending year 10 at ~16bn. Fixed R&D deleverages (EBITDA margin troughs at 33%), SBC stays near 10% of revenue as retention grants continue through the downturn, and Asia/China shipment exposure adds export-control risk. Terminal growth 2.5% and a 15x cap. The scenario stays cash-generative; the zero floor on terminal value is not hit.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: top-10 customer concentration of 82% and dependence on a small number of hyperscaler custom-silicon programmes is the single-customer-type dependency the method singles out, the balance sheet carries net debt plus a 750 earn-out, and a large contested merger is pending. Base 50%: year 1 is anchored to H1 FY2027 actuals and current guidance. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs management's full FY2028 outlook, optical share gains and uninterrupted hyperscaler capex all at once. The pending Lumentum deal is not weighted as deal-completes/deal-breaks: Marvell is the acquirer, closing is 18+ months away, and there is no Lumentum model to value the combined company.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Marvell is valued on strict owner FCF: SBC is expensed in full (it is running above 10% of revenue after the Celestial deal), working capital is charged as growth consumes it, technology-licence payments are treated as capex, and the Celestial earn-out and restructuring obligations are deducted from equity. On that basis the business earned ~565 of owner FCF in FY2026 against a market value above 140bn, so the valuation rests almost entirely on how long 30%+ data-center growth lasts and on margins maturing to the mid-40s. The street basis (SBC added back) is shown alongside; the gap between the two is large for this issuer.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: top-10 customers 82% of FY2026 revenue; four customers are 72% of receivables. One lost XPU generation moves the base case materially.

Lumentum merger (all-stock, ~33% of the combined company to Lumentum holders, close H1 calendar 2028, reported ~3.2bn reverse termination fee): not modelled. Overpayment would lower per-share value below this standalone figure; the deal is the largest single unknown in the valuation.
Guidance dependence: year 1 is management's ~12bn FY2027 outlook and year 2 is 93% of its ~18bn FY2028 outlook. Q3 FY2027 results (~2026-12-01) will test both.
SBC run-rate: Q2 FY2027 SBC was 326 (11.9% of revenue), double the prior-year quarter. If that is the new level rather than an acquisition spike, the 6% terminal assumption is too generous.
Working capital and capacity prepayments absorbed 660 in H1 FY2027; the -30% capture is an estimate from two periods.
Cash tax: currently single-digit; the ramp to 16% is a judgment about Pillar Two and the run-off of intangible amortisation shields.
Terminal value is the majority of enterprise value in every scenario; a 1pt WACC change moves the base value by roughly 15-20%.
Earn-out liability is fair-valued at the 1 August 2026 share price and will move with the stock.
Export controls: ~42% of H1 FY2027 revenue shipped to China, ~84% to Asia.
Customer warrant for 59M shares at 206.58: no dilution at these values, but it caps upside above the strike and vests as a reduction to revenue.
